There are a ton of factors in play when you talk automation and some hopefully will be addressed by the new administration. As a business owner I'm not the devil everyone tries to paint us to be these days. We are trying to remain profitable as a business so we can continue to take care of the employees we do have. There will always be jobs for those that need/want them but just not going to be the same as before. In comment reply yesterday I wrote about my hope that they fix the work week claus and that they can hopefully move the production of these Kiosks into the US at some point in the future to help our country instead of China. In the end though, we have a fine line as a business to walk along with everyone else. If I can't remain profitable though, how should I employee the other 600 people that work for me? People deserve a livable wage but as a business we have to remain profitable. I can raise menu prices to ridiculous prices that would drive away business and or negates the raise in wages or I can make changes in how efficiently the store runs and pass those savings to customers. We are in the business to build bridges not burn them and this is one step that will allow us to remain profitable while also minimizing the changes to things like menu pricing etc... It's easy to stand on the fence and say one thing or another. It's another thing to be invested in these franchises and care about the people and know that this was our best option for our current environment.
